title: jmap-mail-server: resolve #creationId in /set Id props
description: Follow-up to JMAP-8ypy. jmap-server now passes CallContext::created_ids (request-wide creation id -> id map, RFC 8620 §3.3/§5.3) and exports resolve_creation_ref. mail-server (canonical extension server) /set handlers still treat '#x' as a literal id: Email/set mailboxIds keys (RFC 8621 §4.6), Mailbox/set parentId (RFC 8621 §2.5), EmailSubmission/set identityId/emailId (RFC 8621 §7.5). Thread cx.created_ids through reg! into handle_*_set and resolve each Id-typed property; unknown #ref -> invalidProperties SetError naming the property. Mirror to siblings via the follow-up sweep bead.
